scripts.build: npm run check && cross-env ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build && npm run build:corpus-index && npm run check:search-isolation
scripts.check: node scripts/check-public-release.mjs && cross-env ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro check
scripts.test:operator: node --check operator_console/ui/app.js && python3 -m unittest discover -s operator_console/tests -p 'test_*.py' -v
scripts.test:static-tools: node --test scripts/tests/*.test.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_*.py' -v
scripts.test:python: npm run test:operator && npm run test:corpus && npm run test:acquisition && npm run test:pipeline && npm run test:evaluation
